verdict.rationale: treg documents a side-by-side comparison of providers for a platform with measured success rate, speed and price (`/catalog/platforms/{slug}`). It also collects per-call usefulness reviews, but nothing shows those reviews being published as aggregate scores. The evidence is a single docs line, and `treg health` covers credential health rather than server liveness. missing for 10: published usage counts, verification badges, published aggregate review scores or ratings, endpoint liveness/health checks, independent or hands-on corroboration of the comparison view.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges

citations.quote: `/catalog/platforms/{slug}` lists them side by side with measured success rate, speed and price.
rate that one call after using it with `treg review CALL_ID USEFULNESS [--reason "..."]`
